findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.forkmate.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_preferences · Private data: give_consent · Public sink: whoami, log_meal, send_feedback · Destructive: update_preferences, delete_meal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_preferences · Private data: give_consent · Public sink: whoami, log_meal, send_feedback · Destructive: update_preferences, delete_meal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_preferences · Private data: search_foods · Public sink: update_meal · Destructive: update_meal, delete_meal, remove_pantry_item

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
detail: Tool "search_foods" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts for foods matching a query, returning candidates with macros and a `source` you can show the user.
